name: go-dev-mcp
description: Go development tools for Claude: package documentation (Go, Rust, Python), GitHub integration, code outlining, and local file search.
long_description: GoDevMCP is a local MCP server that provides Go (and Rust/Python) development tools to Claude. It includes documentation search and reading for pkg.go.dev, docs.rs, and docs.python.org; GitHub code search, content, diffs, issues, pull requests, and workflow runs; directory tree visualization; local file content search; Go package outlining and validation; and markdown scanning. All tools are read-only and run locally over stdio.

tools.name: tree_dir
tools.description: Display a local directory tree with depth limiting.

tools.name: search_godoc
tools.description: Search for Go packages on pkg.go.dev.

tools.name: read_godoc
tools.description: Read Go package documentation with paging and caching.

tools.name: search_within_godoc
tools.description: Search for keywords within a Go package's documentation.

tools.name: search_github_code
tools.description: Search code across GitHub repositories.

tools.name: get_github_content
tools.description: Get file content from a GitHub repository with paging.

tools.name: get_github_diff
tools.description: Get a unified diff between two git refs on GitHub.

tools.name: list_github_issues
tools.description: List issues for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_github_issue
tools.description: Get a single GitHub issue with body and comments.

tools.name: list_github_pulls
tools.description: List pull requests for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_github_pull
tools.description: Get a single GitHub pull request with body and changed files.

tools.name: list_github_workflow_runs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository.

tools.name: get_github_workflow_run
tools.description: Get a GitHub Actions workflow run with jobs and step results.

tools.name: tree_github_repo
tools.description: Display a GitHub repository tree with depth limiting.

tools.name: search_local_files
tools.description: Search file contents in local directories with match limiting.

tools.name: outline_go_package
tools.description: Outline a Go package: dependencies, declarations, and call graph.

tools.name: scan_markdown
tools.description: Extract heading hierarchy and line numbers from markdown files.

tools.name: validate_go_code
tools.description: Validate Go code with vet, build, formatting, and module checks.

tools.name: search_rustdoc
tools.description: Search for Rust crates on docs.rs.

tools.name: read_rustdoc
tools.description: Read Rust crate documentation from docs.rs with paging and caching.

tools.name: search_within_rustdoc
tools.description: Search for keywords within a Rust crate's documentation.

tools.name: search_pydoc
tools.description: Search Python standard library modules on docs.python.org.

tools.name: read_pydoc
tools.description: Read Python module documentation from docs.python.org with paging and caching.

tools.name: search_within_pydoc
tools.description: Search for keywords within a Python module's documentation.
